posts.text: Path Of Success For Traders — Hi, I am Shailesh Thapa, Friends why traders are failing , in one clear point is, they don’t know the chart reading. Markets runs with the help of candles which makes demand zone and supply zone but without knowing any knowledge of zone people start to trade. To be a trader you need to give time to chart reading. What you should read on chart:- On any chart DZ (Demand Zone and Supply Zone (SZ ) is formed with the help of candle wicks, you should focus on candle wicks, unless you understand the candle wicks you can not be a trader.
